player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Sauna and the Gallery, repeatedly moving east and west without exploring other options. I prematurely chose "DONE" while the Gallery still offered unvisited directions (south). Next time, I will prioritize exploring all available directions from each room before returning to a previous one. Specifically, from the Gallery, I will try "south" immediately after arriving, and only return to the Sauna if no new rooms are found in the Gallery. I will continue this systematic exploration until I have visited every reachable room and confirmed no new directions exist, at which point I will issue "DONE".
